summary.text: Mike Marvin won the Legal Marijuana Now Party primary and is on the Nov. 3, 2026 general-election ballot for U.S. Senate. His campaign website states that, citing worsening health, he cannot put in the effort the race requires, will remain on the ballot, and urges supporters to back Dan Osborn.

paragraphs.text: Earned a high school diploma from Dominican High School.
Career experience includes serving as executive director of the Nebraska Association of Public Employees (described by Ballotpedia as a former role).
